# Batch 2A — weight and space: 17 Titanic, 21 Cowl Shadow, 09 Skeenhead, 11 Slapback Strut

*Generated by `tests/voicing/batch02a.py --index`. Each folder: `A` original (through the base program path), `B` centre (the recommended variant and the committed patch), `C`, `D` along the axes named below. WAV names: `<variant>_<tag>_<phrase>.wav`, phrases riff / stabs / held (the pilot phrases) and the patch's own (slow = f, slowmid = f2, skank = g, surf = h). The WAVs are on the `listen/batch-02a-weight-and-space` branch only; the full tables (`README.md`, `numbers.md`, `results.json`) are in each folder and on the voicing branch. Level: matched to -18.0 dBFS RMS (README section 10 says on what).*
